# Chart Line

```tsx
import { ChartLine } from "@s0l/design-system"
```

A line chart with its axes and Legend. Mirrors the Figma Chart Line: give it `lines`, and optionally `xLabels`, and hovering a node shows its values. Without `xLabels`, the longest line sets the nodes. The width follows the container.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
renderChart(allArgs, lineCount, nodes)
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Chart Line: Y Axis, X Axis + Lines, and the Legend. Lines and Nodes are not variants here: they come from `lines` and `xLabels`, so any amount works, and with no `xLabels` the longest line sets the nodes. Each .Chart Line Segment leaves a node flat and arrives at the next one flat, with its control points crossed at 2/3 of the way.
The numbers in Figma are samples: the Y Axis starts at 0 and grows with the values, which can be of any size or sign, and the Legend shows each line's total. A node with no value leaves a gap in its line.
The width follows the container: the plot stretches and only the strokes keep their 2px, so nothing has to be measured to draw it. Measuring only thins out the X labels that no longer fit and flips the overlay near the right edge.
Hovering a node shows the Hover Handoff: the Border/Strong line, the Medium label, one .Indicator Value per line and the Chart Line Legend Overlay. Figma Chart Line Frame: the lines take 191px and the X labels the other 32px.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`ChartLineProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | `ChartLineSeries[]` | Figma Lines. |
| `xLabels?` | `string[]` | Figma Nodes: one label per node, on the X Axis. Without them, the longest line sets the nodes, numbered from 1. |
| `yTicks?` | `number[]` | The Y Axis labels. By default they come from the values. A value outside these stops at the edge of the chart. |
| `formatValue?` | `(value: number) => string` | What the overlay and the Legend show for a value. |

## Types

`ChartLineProps`, `ChartLineSeries`

## Rules

- Import `ChartLine` from `@s0l/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
